patents.title: SECRET UNIT "Mammalia" FOR BREAST-FEEDING CLOTHES
patents.abstract: AbstractFIELD: personal use articles.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of clothing manufacture of ladies' apparel articles and to secret unit for breast-feeding. Secret piece includes back and front part made of fabric or jersey cloth. Front part consists of at least two parts - upper yoke and lower forepart and is equipped with at least two shoulder straps. Yoke is arranged as floating or with elements of fixation, and its lower cut is arranged below breast level. Upper part of forepart is cut out as a tank top, cut of armhole is treated separately from article, and shoulder straps are continuation of armhole, which are fixed in shoulder seams or pass around neck, and are also arranged with the possibility to adjust length and radius of turn.EFFECT: invention provides convenience and simplicity of use.10 cl, 13 dwg

patents.title: Shaping garment
patents.abstract: AbstractThe present disclosure generally pertains to a shapewear garment with an integrated compression liner. The liner is constructed from a singular tubular piece of fabric and provides 360° of compression. The liner is seamless, thus allowing for a smooth appearance. The liner is attached to an outer fashion garment to prevent twisting or turning of the piece. The garment includes a plurality of yarn stitches to provide greater support in the chest and stomach regions. The liner and outer garment may take a T-shirt or tank top configuration with a number of different necklines and lengths.

patents.title: The one-piece dress that one clothing is worn more
patents.abstract: AbstractTranslated fromChinese本发明涉及一种一衣多穿的连衣裙，其特征在于，在由后领贴及前领贴形成的领贴上设有扣眼，扣位扣到扣眼上，通过扣眼更换不同领型的衣领；当车缝前袖窿贴及后袖窿贴时，通过拉链与袖山拉链拉到一起，使得袖子通过拉链成为可拆卸的衣袖，并通过拉链更换不同长度、不同款式的衣袖；在由后中片、后侧片、前侧片、前中片形成的衣身上设有口袋，不同款式的口袋通过口袋结合部可拆卸地设置在衣身上；衣裙与衣身间通过衣裙结合部相连，使得衣裙通过衣裙结合部成为可拆卸的衣裙。本发明基于相同的领围、相同的袖窿设计连衣裙的一衣多穿，通过圆领、可拆卸式立领、可拆卸衬衫领、无袖、可拆卸式七分袖、可拆卸式衣长互相组合，从而形成多种穿着方式。The invention relates to a one-piece multi-wear dress, which is characterized in that buttonholes are arranged on the collar stickers formed by the back collar stickers and the front collar stickers, the buttons are fastened to the buttonholes, and collars of different collar types can be replaced through the buttonholes ; When the front armhole stickers and the rear armhole stickers are sewn, the sleeves are pulled together by the zipper and the sleeve mountain zipper, so that the sleeves become detachable sleeves through the zipper, and the sleeves of different lengths and styles can be replaced by the zipper; There are pockets on the bodice formed by the back middle piece, back side piece, front side piece, and front middle piece. The pockets of different styles are detachably set on the bodice through the pocket junction; the skirt and the bodice are connected through the skirt junction are connected so that the dress becomes a detachable dress through the dress joint. The present invention is based on the same collar circumference, the same armhole design dresses can be worn in one garment, through round neck, detachable stand-up collar, detachable shirt collar, sleeveless, detachable three-quarter sleeves, detachable dress length mutual Combined to form a variety of ways to wear.
